title: Formal Resurgence and Differential Transcendence in Lean 4 (stokes-vandermonde)
description: Lean 4 formalization of the Borel–Stokes–Vandermonde criterion and machine-checked proofs of differential transcendence, spectral positivity, and parity dichotomies across analytic number theory, spectral geometry, combinatorics, special functions, and mathematical physics. Version 3.6.0 adds Wave 11 (8,230 new lines across 3 strictly additive modules under PakStokes/AllD/, bringing PakStokesAllD to 22,898 lines across 13 modules) proved 100% unconditionally from Mathlib with zero external hypotheses: (1) Multiplicative Quotient-Rank & Forest Independence (SquareQuotientsAndDivisors.lean): general full-row-rank Laurent-monomial transfer (monomial_family_diff_indep_of_logDeriv), square-partition monomial & forest quotient theorems (squarePart_monomial_family_diff_indep, squarePart_forest_quotients_diff_indep), joint differential independence of distinct-square partitions Q_2(q) and overpartitions into squares (distinctSquares_overpartSquares_joint_diff_indep), k-regular and distinct-square dilations, and 1D ideal Fermi–Dirac gas dilations (fermi1D_dilations_diff_indep); (2) Square-Divisor Generating Function L_{2,0}(q) = sum_{N >= 1} d_square(N) q^N: unified d = 2 zero-tilt wave-profile engine (SqRayProfile), closed-form elementary Poisson-summation identity (squareDivisor_analytic_identity), non-ADE (squareDivisor_non_ade), and all finite distinct dilations (squareDivisor_dilations_diff_indep); (3) Physical 3D Ideal Bose–Einstein Condensate & 3D Fermi–Dirac Gas on the periodic cubic torus T^3 at unit fugacity z = 1 (Bec3DAnalytic.lean, Bec3DDiffTrans.lean): closed-form 3D iterated Poisson summation + elementary K_{1/2} identity for the internal energy F_BEC^(3)(e^{-1/X^2}) (bec3D_analytic_identity), differential transcendence of Z_BEC^(3)(q), all nonzero integer powers Z_BEC^(3)(q)^k, all finite distinct dilations, Z_FD^(3)(q) and its dilations, single-temperature joint independence (Z_BEC^(3), Z_FD^(3)), and full-row-rank / forest quotient independence (bec3D_bose_fermi_quotient_rank, bec3D_forest_quotients_diff_indep); and (4) Coupled 1D + 3D Ideal Quantum Gases via Dirichlet primes in arithmetic progressions (7 mod 8 vs. 1 mod 4): joint differential independence of all 1D+3D Bose dilations (bec1D_bec3D_dilations_diff_indep), of (P_2(q), Z_BEC^(3)(q)) (powerPart2_bec3D_joint_diff_indep), of (Z_BEC^(1)(q), Z_BEC^(3)(q)) (bec1D_bec3D_joint_diff_indep), and of all four ideal quantum gas partition functions (Z_BEC^(1), Z_FD^(1), Z_BEC^(3), Z_FD^(3)) simultaneously at a single temperature variable (quantumGases_1D_3D_bose_fermi_joint_diff_indep). All 288 audited declarations across Waves 1-11 depend strictly on standard Lean axioms ([propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] or subsets thereof) and pass independent leanchecker --fresh replay. Prime-number-theorem inputs use MediumPNT from PrimeNumberTheoremAnd (PNT+) by Alex Kontorovich, Terence Tao, and contributors. Google Gemini, OpenAI Codex, and Anthropic Claude assisted with exploration, auditing, drafting, and Lean formalization.
